models.title: DFMA 15-Fin Aluminum Heat Sink
models.summary: Forced-convection 15-fin Al 6061-T6 heat sink sized for a 50.8 × 50.8 mm, 100 W CPU in 25 °C ambient air (85 °C limit, 70 °C target). MATLAB resistance model predicts 69.85 °C (0.4485 °C/W) and Fusion 360 steady-state FEA predicts 69.775 °C max; cut mass 27.5% vs. 17-fin baseline (75.3 g to 54.6 g). Bench test pending.
models.sourceNote: Coursework project (ENGG 114 Heat Transfer, Hofstra University). Analysis and simulation only; not bench-tested.
